# PFP and Symbol Game: current agent route

> Active application: pfp. AuthorityEffect: None.
> Primary goal: a simple, cost-effective, repeatable PFP demonstration.
> Secondary goal: targeted discovery producing useful guidance or code repairs.
> No fixed pilot grid or exhaustive mode/stage cross-product is required.

## Execute and understand

- [Finite-QM workflow](docs/22_unified_pfp_v4_operad_workflow_and_hacks.md): actual prompt_template.yaml, six stages, one derivation mode, six attached LLM techniques, residual repair and native certificate checking. The source catalog stays separate.
- [Documentation hub](README.md): goals, navigation and evidence limits.
- [Practical PFP](_how_to_play/13_practical_pfp_and_discovery.md): seed preparation, human/IDE witness, live run, replay and discovery.
- [Current types and lessons](docs/16_current_types_and_learnings.md): existing contracts, mode status, prompt-attached antibodies and applied repairs.
- [Stages](_how_to_play/10_eight_stage_pipeline.md): contiguous stages; stage 5 is host evaluation.
- [Outputs and refusals](_how_to_play/12_output_layout_and_troubleshooting.md): captured bytes, accounting and safe diagnosis.
- [Application guide](../../../pfp/documentation/pfp_seed_execution.md): detailed current CLI usage.
- [Bounded results](../../../pfp/documentation/pfp_consolidation_plan.md#bounded-implementation-handoff--2026-10-12): recorded live/replay observations and outstanding errors.
- [Numbered prompt roles and PO035 play](docs/16_numbered_prompt_roles_and_po035_play.md): experimental contracts and collated bounded failures.
- [Runtime ownership and historical replay](docs/17_runtime_ownership_and_replay.md): canonical application, descriptive research modules and source-pinned replay.
- [Pilot status at 201dc8d, 2026-10-15](README.md#pilot-status-at-201dc8d-2026-10-15): pilot locations, results so far, known defects and the EPIC-OE-OEWAS-012 stages.

entrypoints. A listed mode, parsed schema or generated Markdown file is not
execution evidence or admission. Use exact source/candidate bindings; preserve
